name: H. A. Sprague
role: Black Hills member of the territorial legislature
bio: H. A. Sprague was one of the Black Hills members of the territorial legislature credited by the Cow Boy with passing the fence law and repealing the herd law in March 1885. That month he passed through Medora on his way home from Bismarck to the Hills.

moments.label: Credited with helping pass the fence law

mentions: …following were among the passengers from the Hills: Hon. John R. Wilson and wife, Hon. A. McCall, Hon. H. A. Sprague, Hon. H. M. Gregg, J. A. Bishop, Kane Holland, Hon. G. T. Bennett and John P. Belding, sheriff of Lawrence county.
PASSED!! THE FENCE LAW ESTABLISHED AND THE HERD LAW REPEALED!!

…unty and the active co-operation of all the other Hills members, Messrs. Wells, Washabaugh, Martin, Gregg and Sprague is due the establishment of this law. To them, more than to anyone else we looked for support of the measure, as there is a strict fence law in the Hills, and nobly did…
